positions.name: AnalyticsDbMigration
positions.frame: what is the stated case for changing the analytics database platform?
positions.why: The principal's assertion (src-1) and the animator's structured breakdown (src-2 migration target, src-3 performance gain, src-4 timeline) all cohere under one directional read: the rationale and parameters for switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB — the migration itself, the 10x analytical-query performance justification, and the Q3 2026 target.
